answer: Delay every new agent's earnings in a time-locked vault: rewards vest only after the identity survives several epochs with no fraud report, and any proven fraud forfeits the whole balance. A prism of delayed payouts splits the attacker's payoff across time, so a sparrow of fake identities cannot cash out quickly; like pigment that only sets after it dries, value appears only after a clean record. Honest agents wait once; a sybil farmer must fund thousands of identities through the same long wait, tying up capital for months while earning nothing.
